post.description:
Log in with username and password; sets the session cookie.

Every failure gives the same 401 ``LOGIN_FAILED``.

Set the password with a setup or reset code, then log in.

If the login fails afterwards (a locked account or address), the password
is set nevertheless and the answer is the 401 of ``/login``.
End this session and delete the cookie.

post.description:
Upload and atomically import a work package archive (system admins).

A new project gets the uploader as a member with every role, so the
dashboard flow keeps working until projects are imported by the CLI
(T2d). Runs in the thread pool (plain ``def``); the body is copied with a
size cap.

get.description:
List documents showing metadata only, without proposal counts.

The status is the logged-in user's; a system admin or a lead of the
project may ask for another annotator's. Review mode is refused to a user
whose roles do not give it; in it each document says whether it has
proposals, so review navigation can skip documents there is nothing to
review in.

Raises:
    AccessDenied: ``MODE_NOT_ALLOWED`` (403) for review mode without it.

get.description:
Export scoped workspace package as downloadable ZIP.

Filename: ``<package_id>__<annotator_id>__<document_id>__<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip``.

Export all work of one annotator on a package as one v2 work package.

The annotator is the logged-in user (``annotator_id`` omitted or their own
pseudonym); a system admin or a lead of the project may export another
annotator's work (Q5).
Includes every document of the package and all of the annotator's
submissions, submitted annotations and search events in ``mode`` (all
modes if omitted). Filename:
``<package_id>__<annotator_id>__<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS>.zip``.
Search languages from the package's immutable first-use resource capture.

post.description:
Upload an ontology (``.json``) or a translation file (``.tsv``).

The file goes to the ontology store (blob store and ``ontology_files``,
audited as ``ontology.add``) and is registered at every start. A
translation file (babelon TSV, e.g. ``hp-de.babelon.tsv``) replaces a file
of that name, and the ontology it belongs to is reloaded. System admins
only. Until T3 this route stays for the web UI; the admin CLI is the
supported way (D5).
